```{python}
#| tags: [parameters]
tickers = ["BA", "AAPL", "GOOG"]
```

```{python}
import helpers
stocks = {ticker: helpers.get_stock(ticker) for ticker in tickers}
data_dict = {ticker: helpers.get_data(stocks[ticker]) for ticker in tickers}
```

# {.tabset}

```{python}
#| output: asis

for ticker in tickers:
    data = data_dict[ticker]
    change = helpers.get_change(data)
    ohlc = helpers.make_OHLC_table(data)
    
    print(f"\n## {ticker}\n")
    
    # Row 1 - Value boxes
    print("### Row {height=25%}\n")
    
    print(f"""
```{{python}}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Current Price"
dict(
    icon = "currency-dollar",
    color = "secondary",
    value = "{helpers.get_price(data)}"
)
```

```{{python}}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Change"
dict(
    value = "{change['amount']}",
    icon = "{change['icon']}",
    color = "{change['color']}"
)
```

```{{python}}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Percent Change"
dict(
    icon = "percent",
    color = "light",
    value = "{change['percent']}"
)
```
""")
    
    # Row 2 - Chart and table
    print("### Row {height=75%}\n")
    print("#### Column {width=75%}\n")
    
    fig = helpers.make_candlestick_chart(data, ticker.upper())
    fig.show()
    
    print(f"\n#### Column {{width=25%}}\n")
    print(f"""
::: {{.card}}
**Last Close: {ohlc['date']}**

| Metric | Value |
|:-------|------:|
| Close  | {ohlc['close']} |
| Open   | {ohlc['open']} |
| High   | {ohlc['high']} |
| Low    | {ohlc['low']} |
| Volume | {ohlc['volume']} |
: {{.striped}}
:::
""")
```
